label: Beef meal

source.name: Our World in Data, based on Poore & Nemecek (2018), Science

methodology: OWID reports a global-average footprint of ~60 kg CO2eq per kg of beef (farm to retail, including land-use change). Converted to a per-meal figure assuming a 150 g cooked-meat serving, a commonly used reference serving size. Actual footprints vary widely by production system and portion size.

label: Chicken meal

source.name: Our World in Data, based on Poore & Nemecek (2018), Science

methodology: OWID reports a global-average footprint of ~6.1 kg CO2eq per kg of poultry meat. Converted to a per-meal figure assuming a 150 g cooked-meat serving.

label: Vegetarian meal
methodology: Scarborough et al. found self-selected vegetarian diets in the UK produce ~3.81 kg CO2e/day. Divided by an assumed 3 meals/day to estimate a per-meal figure.

label: Vegan meal
methodology: Scarborough et al. found self-selected vegan diets in the UK produce ~2.89 kg CO2e/day. Divided by an assumed 3 meals/day to estimate a per-meal figure.
